name: lift_1i
expr: if(abs((mod(crank_angle - firing["1"].slot * firing_interval - intake_centre + 360 deg, 720 deg) - 360 deg)) < intake_duration / 2, tappet_lift * cos(180 deg * (mod(crank_angle - firing["1"].slot * firing_interval - intake_centre + 360 deg, 720 deg) - 360 deg) / intake_duration)^2, 0 mm)

name: gamma_1i
